name: Airborne Company
help: Drop things from the sky -- Paratroopers, Supplies, and Hellfire from P-47 bombing runs. Ideal for Recon and Raiding operations against the Enemy.

name: Armor Company
help: Slow to build up strength, the Armor Commander is rewarded for their patience with the most powerful Allied Tanks in the game.

name: Infantry Company
help: The backbone of the Allied army. Focuses on Defenses, Off-Map Artillery, and Heavy Infantry Ranger. A well-rounded tree ideally suited to defensive players.

name: Blitzkrieg Doctrine
help: Carry out fast assault ops by deploying overwhelming force. Strong assault Reinforcements and production bonuses help promote a strategy of aggressive expansion.

name: Defensive Doctrine
help: Focuses on enforcing a stranglehold on Territory and favors defensive players. Fortify your front line and bombard Enemy positions with Artillery Strikes.

name: Terror Doctrine
help: Propaganda inspires courage in your Troops as well as inspiring fear in your enemies, and if that is not sufficient to overcome them, the Tiger Ace and V1 Rockets can be very convincing.

name: Luftwaffe Tactics
help: Anti-tank Air support as well as solid defense options round out the Luftwaffe tree to help the Panzer Elite gain a foothold and keep it. Choosing this tree will grant the Kettenkrad with Camouflage or the Schwimmwagen with Mark Target.

name: Scorched Earth Tactics
help: Bombs, traps and tricks make it difficult for your opponent to maneuver around the battlefield. Bombard your enemy with the brutal power of Hummel 150mm Artillery. Choosing this tree will grant the Kettenkrad with Booby Traps or the Schwimmwagen with Scorched Earth.

name: Tank Destroyer Tactics
help: Destroy enemy tanks with superior Axis tanks and munitions. Choosing this tree will grant the Kettenkrad with Repairs or the Schwimmwagen with Mines.

name: Royal Artillery Support
help: Royal Artillery Support brings advanced abilities, mobile artillery units, and introduces new battlefield artillery doctrines.

name: Royal Commandos Support
help: Elite assault troops and tanks can be dropped in by gliders. Recon and artillery support add to the versatility of the Royal Commandos.

name: Royal Engineers Support
help: Royal Engineers can improve all defensive emplacements, enable armor to go Hull Down, and call in heavily Armored Churchill tanks.
